name: scram-desktop
description: Scram Desktop: Scram in a desktop window, plus a local MCP server so AI agents on your computer (Claude, Codex, Cursor…) can build in Scram through its AI chat.
author: Scram Software Limited

scripts.dist:win: npm run build:connector && electron-builder --config installer/electron-builder.yml --win --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build:connector && electron-builder --config installer/electron-builder.yml --mac --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build:connector && electron-builder --config installer/electron-builder.yml --linux --publish never
